Break the banana into pieces and put it in a blender with milk, whey protein and oats. Blend for about 30 seconds until creamy. Drink straight away, as the shake thickens over time.
Peel the banana and slice it. Spread peanut butter on top or eat it on the side.

Mash the banana, add oats, eggs and 100 g low-fat quark. Blend into a batter or stir well, then leave to swell for 5 min. Cook small pancakes in a non-stick pan over medium heat for 2 min per side. Serve with berries or the rest of the quark.

Cook the basmati rice according to the packet, unless it's already cooked. Fry the vegetable mix in a pot or pan for 5 min, add curry powder and toast briefly. Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 5 min. Salt the trout, break it into pieces, add to the sauce and let it cook gently over low heat for 5–6 min. Serve with the rice.
